summary: Tested the Aay-Vyay (Income & Expense) report end-to-end. Backend: 9/10 pytest pass. Monthly, weekly (Mon–Sun, empty weeks included, first week clipped to the range), yearly (FY 2025-26 / FY 2026-27) buckets are correct. Group-wise heads add up to 100%. A journal Dr to an expense head adds to expense, and a jama to an expense head reduces it. Bad period or date gives 400, swapped dates are handled, and investment_group_ids filtering works (a TEST party under FIXED ASSETS showed as investment 7000 and OTHER DEPOSITS was excluded). The 1 failure is an older generic bug in PUT /settings that the new picker now triggers: a partial PUT resets firm_name to '9x Vyapari'. Frontend: all requested flows work — default Monthly FY range, Aug row scoping (₹ 10,200.00 and heads with %), head links, clear selection, weekly (53 rows) and yearly tabs, quick buttons, URL params, investment picker (asset groups only, untick OTHER DEPOSITS takes investment 35,45,022 → 0, then restored), DOS sheet toggle, print stub called, Excel with Summary and Heads sheets, nav item key R, Alt+R works, and /rokad and /trial-balance still load.

critical.issue: SettingsIn.firm_name defaults to '9x Vyapari' (it is not None or ''), so it is never filtered out. Any partial PUT, e.g. the Investment groups picker sending {investment_group_ids:[...]} or SettleToggle sending {settle_accounts...}, overwrites the user's firm name with '9x Vyapari'. Reproduced: set firm_name 'TEST_IE45 FIRM', PUT {investment_group_ids}, GET returns '9x Vyapari'.

minor.issue: Bills on heads: a purchase bill on an expense-nature head counts as -net (Cr), so it REDUCES expense. If purchase bills are ever booked against PURCHASE A/C or expense ledgers, the sign is likely wrong. Please check the intended semantics.
Once someone saves via the picker, settings store an explicit list, so the default heuristic no longer applies to asset groups created later. Acceptable, but worth a note in the UI.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the PUT /settings default bug, saving the picker silently resets a custom firm name to '9x Vyapari'. Fix on the backend: make firm_name default None.

issues: 'Is mahine' keeps the current period tab. Coming from Yearly, it shows a single 'FY 2026-27' row for this month; consider switching to monthly or weekly.
'3 saal' sets from = today minus 2 years on the 1st of the month (2024-10-01), so FY 2024-25 is a partial year; consider fy_start of 2 years back (2024-04-01).
Excel 'Heads' sheet GRAND TOTAL adds expense + income + investment amounts together (25,200 for Aug), which has no meaning; drop it or show it per type only.
Date inputs use the browser's native date picker. This is consistent with the rest of the app, so it is only a note.

action_items: HIGH: in SettingsIn change firm_name default to None (or use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) in PUT /settings) so partial updates from the IE picker or SettleToggle don't reset firm_name
Decide the sign for purchase bills on expense heads in the income-expense report
Optional UX: 'Is mahine' → switch to monthly or weekly; '3 saal' → start from the FY start; remove the mixed GRAND TOTAL in the Excel Heads sheet

rca of the issue: PUT /settings: SettingsIn(firm_name='9x Vyapari' default) → model_dump() includes firm_name even when the client didn't send it → the filter only drops None or '' → $set firm_name='9x Vyapari'. Mitigation: body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) or firm_name: Optional[str] = None.
